title: Add Link to YouTube TOS
body:
As the YouTube API owner, I want to see a link to the YouTube Terms of Service on the site, https://www.youtube.com/t/terms and the Goolge Privacy Policy. 

- Add link somewhere to https://video.odl.mit.edu/terms/

> Thank you for working with us on the YouTube API Services Compliance Review.  We have reviewed your response.

> In order to complete the Quota request, Please fix the mentioned violations to be in compliance with  YouTube API Services - Developer Policies 
 
> Policy #: III.A.1,2 (link)( API Client Terms of Use and Privacy Policies)

> Violation: No reference to YouTube Terms of Service (ToS) in API Client’s ToS.


> No reference/link to Google Privacy Policy. 

> Proposed Solution: Kindly add links o YouTube ToS in your terms of service page and Google Privacy policy in your Privacy Policy Page.
Please fix the violation in the next three (3) business days and feel free to reach out to us if you have any questions.
 
> We look forward to completing your YouTube API Services Compliance review.
  
> Regards, 
 

> YouTube API Compliance Team.
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
